settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.content:
How does the subscription work?

Each month, we'll send you a curated box of premium products based on your subscription tier. You'll be charged automatically on the same day each month.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes! You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account dashboard. No questions asked.

Do you ship internationally?

Currently, we ship to all EU countries. Shipping is included in your subscription price.
